title: New York City Public Schools banning AI use through middle school starting this year
hook_text: NYC Bans AI in Middle Schools
script:
New York City Public Schools is banning AI use through middle school starting this year.
The new restrictions apply specifically to students up through the eighth grade.
High schools will handle technology policies differently under separate guidelines.
Education advocates previously pushed for formal guardrails on classroom tech.
Would you restrict AI in middle school classrooms?
